query:
SELECT
                CASE WHEN project_count > 0 THEN 'Atleast 1 Project'
                ELSE 'No Projects' END as "name!",
                COUNT(*)::int as "value!"
            FROM (
                SELECT u.id, COUNT(p.id) as project_count
                FROM users u
                LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.user_id = u.id
                GROUP BY u.id
            ) counts
            GROUP BY project_count > 0
